sources: https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_stevens_creek.htm (NPS campgrounds API record for it, read 2026-10-27)

values.note: Loops A, B and C, all paved back-ins. Recreation.gov lists RVs to 30-40 ft on most sites and 48 ft on C54; 51 of the 54 catalogued sites take a 23-ft rig (B22 and B33 are 21 ft, A03 has no length).

sites.source: NPS ('The 53 sites ... Tents to large RVs can be accommodated'; 'This campground is paved') + recreation.gov campsite catalog 234055 (54 sites in loops A/B/C, every one Back-In, Paved; RV lengths 21-48 ft), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: NPS campground record (Toilets 'Vault Toilets - year round'; Potable Water 'Yes - seasonal'; Showers 'None'; Dump Station 'No'; Laundry 'No'; Camp Store 'No') + recreation.gov ('drinking water available late-May to mid-September'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: recreation.gov 234055 rate season 'First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 - 2026-09-30' + NPS ('The campground is usually closed from October through mid-May'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: First-come, first-served: no site can be reserved. Register and pay on site with the Recreation.gov app's Scan & Pay (download it before arriving). Loop A: 14 nights in a 30-day period; other loops 30 consecutive days. Up to 8 people and two camping units per site. Check-in and check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: NPS ('All sites are first-come, first served'; 'This campground uses the Recreation.gov app's Scan & Pay option. Please have the app downloaded before arrival. Registration for campsites are in-person through the app'; regulations page: 'Stevens Creek Campground: Camping is limited to a visit of 14 nights during a 30-day period in Loop A. All other sites are limited to 30 consecutive days per visit') + recreation.gov catalog (all 54 sites 'Not Reservable', rule scanAndPay), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $20 a night, $10 with an Interagency Senior or Access pass.

fees.source: NPS ('$20.00 per night ($10.00 per night with Interagency Senior/Access Pass)') + recreation.gov 2026 rate season (STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: NPS ('$10.00 per night with Interagency Senior/Access Pass'), read 2026-10-27

note: Curecanti NRA campground on the north shore of Blue Mesa Reservoir off US-50, 12 mi west of Gunnison; open sage with no shade. The Stevens Creek boat ramp and its inspection station are closed (2026); the nearest ramps are Elk Creek and Lake Fork. --Claude
